int level[MAXN], adj[MAXN], copy_adj[MAXN], fila[MAXN];

int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

int inds[21][21], inds2[21][21], mk[21][21], c[21][21];
int in;
pair<int,int> q[MAXN];
int rp, cp;

    to[pa] = t; cap[pa] = c; ant[pa] = adj[f]; adj[f] = pa++; 
    to[pa] = f; cap[pa] = 0; ant[pa] = adj[t]; adj[t] = pa++;
}

bool valid(int a, int b) {
    return a >= 0 && a < n && b >= 0 && b < n;
}

void bfs_search(int a, int b) {
    int ini = 0, fim = 0;
    memset(mk, 0, sizeof(mk));
    memset(c, -1, sizeof(c));
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) for (int j=0; j<n; j++) if (gr[i][j] == 'Y') mk[i][j] = 1;

    q[fim++] = make_pair(a, b);
    c[a][b] = c[rp][cp] = 0;
    mk[a][b] = 1;
    mk[rp][cp] = 2;

        if (mk[x][y] == 1 && c[x][y] == t) continue;
        for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
            int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
            if (valid(nx, ny) && mk[nx][ny] == 0) {
                mk[nx][ny] = mk[x][y];
                c[nx][ny] = c[x][y] + 1;
                q[fim++] = make_pair(nx, ny);
            } else if (mk[x][y] == 1 && valid(nx, ny) && mk[nx][ny] == 2 && c[nx][ny] == c[x][y] + 1 && gr2[nx][ny] > '0' && gr2[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                add_edge(inds[a][b], inds2[nx][ny], 9);
            }
        }
    }

    int pos=0, tam=0;

        for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
            if (gr2[i][j]>'0' && gr2[i][j]<='9') {
                add_edge(in, T, gr2[i][j]-'0');
